914:     fn is_short_circuit(
915:         &mut self,
916:         expr: &Expr,
917:         expected_op: BoolOp,
918:         checker: &Checker,
919:     ) -> Option<(Edit, ContentAround)> {
920:         self.taut_hits = self.taut_hits.saturating_add(1);
921:         let Expr::BoolOp(ast::ExprBoolOp {
922:             op,
923:             values,
924:             range: _,
925:         }) = expr
926:         else {
927:             return None;
928:         };
929:         if *op != expected_op {
930:             return None;
931:         }
932:         let short_circuit_truthiness = match op {
933:             BoolOp::And => false,
934:             BoolOp::Or => true,
935:         };
936:         self.taut_short_kind = Some(short_circuit_truthiness);
937:         let mut furthest = expr;
938:         let mut edit = None;
939:         let mut remove = None;
940:         for (index, (value, next_value)) in values.iter().tuple_windows().enumerate() {
941:             let value_truthiness =
942:                 Truthiness::from_expr(value, |id| checker.semantic().has_builtin_binding(id));
943:             let next_value_truthiness =
944:                 Truthiness::from_expr(next_value, |id| checker.semantic().has_builtin_binding(id));
945:             if value_truthiness.is_unknown()
946:                 && (!checker.semantic().in_boolean_test()
947:                     || contains_effect(value, |id| checker.semantic().has_builtin_binding(id)))
948:             {
949:                 furthest = next_value;
950:                 continue;
951:             }
952:             if value_truthiness.into_bool() == Some(short_circuit_truthiness) {
953:                 remove = Some(ContentAround::After);
954:                 edit = Some(self.get_short_circuit_edit(
955:                     value,
956:                     TextRange::new(
957:                         parenthesized_range(
958:                             furthest.into(),
959:                             expr.into(),
960:                             checker.comment_ranges(),
961:                             checker.locator().contents(),
962:                         )
963:                         .unwrap_or(furthest.range())
964:                         .start(),
965:                         expr.end(),
966:                     ),
967:                     short_circuit_truthiness,
968:                     checker.semantic().in_boolean_test(),
969:                     checker.generator(),
970:                 ));
971:                 break;
972:             }
973:             if next_value_truthiness.into_bool() == Some(short_circuit_truthiness) {
974:                 remove = Some(if index + 1 == values.len() - 1 {
975:                     ContentAround::Before
976:                 } else {
977:                     ContentAround::Both
978:                 });
979:                 edit = Some(self.get_short_circuit_edit(
980:                     next_value,
981:                     TextRange::new(
982:                         parenthesized_range(
983:                             furthest.into(),
984:                             expr.into(),
985:                             checker.comment_ranges(),
986:                             checker.locator().contents(),
987:                         )
988:                         .unwrap_or(furthest.range())
989:                         .start(),
990:                         expr.end(),
991:                     ),
992:                     short_circuit_truthiness,
993:                     checker.semantic().in_boolean_test(),
994:                     checker.generator(),
995:                 ));
996:                 break;
997:             }
998:         }
999:         self.taut_remove = remove;
1000:         match (edit, remove) {
1001:             (Some(edit), Some(remove)) => Some((edit, remove)),
1002:             _ => None,
1003:         }
1004:     }
